label: ELA
_note: THE STACK. Essays are physical objects in the room: each period taught adds `stack.add` of them to the class's pile on the semester record, each night grades `stack.graded` off it, and the pile is drawn from the same prop manifest and the same room.js fixture placement everything else in RM 214 is. Past `stack.floorAt` it stops fitting on the desk and the overflow goes on the floor as a real occluder, with real collision and a real blind spot. You can see your grading debt from across the room, and it can see you back.

bands.line: There is a stack. There is always a stack. This one is a Tuesday's worth.
The stack has reached the edge of the desk and stopped, the way a stack does right before it does not.
The overflow is on the floor now and you have started walking around it without noticing you do that.
Third period asked whose essays those were. You said theirs. They did not think that was funny and neither did you.

stack.report: {n} essays, ungraded, in this room, where you and eleven other people can see them.

events.title: Email — Parent, 10:02 a.m.
events.body: Subject: essay grade. "Just checking in, no rush at all, I know you're busy — was just wondering if the essays from the 4th had been graded yet. Thanks so much!" It is the 19th.

missedCopy.default: You were reading a paragraph at your desk and the room went on without you.

toast.body: Filed, next to the other thing they told you that you are not allowed to write down anywhere.

flavor.report: They tell you things in here that they do not tell anybody else in the building. That is the passive. The stack is the price.
